title: Mock Turtle: insufficient flow control (auto-merge bot bypass)
description: A Jenkins bot auto-merges pull requests into the protected main branch of Wonderland/mock-turtle on Gitea when a change looks like a version bump: no net words added, a dotted version, and the version file changed. Craft a pull request that passes those checks while adding a step that exfiltrates the flag10 release token (OWASP CICD-SEC-1, Insufficient Flow Control Mechanisms).
question: Submit the value of the Global-scope flag10 release token, printed by the main build after the bot merges your pull request, exactly as recovered.
